body.p: Claims 1-20 are pending in the current application. Claims 1-8 are withdrawn from consideration. Claims 9-17 and 20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being obvious over U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2017/0371507 to Cengil et al. ("Cengil") in view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2006/0284839 to Breed et al. ("Breed"). Claim 18 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being obvious over Cengil and Breed, and in further view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2014/0116178 to Sata ("Sata"). Claim 19 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being obvious over Cengil and Breed, and in further view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2006/0224945 to Kahn et al. ("Khan"). Reconsideration is respectfully requested in view of the remarks and amendments submitted herewith.

Claims 9, 10, 12, 14, and 16-19 have been amended as shown hereinabove. Support for these claims may be found in the specification, figures and claims as originally filed. No new matter has been entered through this amendment and entry is respectfully requested. Summary of Examiner Interview
The undersigned thanks Examiner McAndrews for the telephonic interview of April 22, 2024. Agreement was reached that the claims as amended overcome the prior art of record.

As agreed by the Examiner during a call with the Examiner on April 22, 2024, the title as previously amended addressed all objections. Withdrawal of the objection and reconsideration are respectfully requested.

As noted hereinabove, claims 9-17 and 20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being obvious over Cengil and Breed. Claim 18 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being obvious over Cengil and Breed, and in further view of Sata. Claim 19 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being obvious over Cengil and Breed, and in further view of Khan.

As agreed to by the Examiner the cited references fail to teach or fairly suggest at least "output a menu of driving mode options including the recommended driving mode with the output device in response to an operation of one of the plurality of paddle shifters," as is recited in independent claims 9 and similarly recited in independent claim 16, as amended.

Based on the foregoing, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 9 and 16, and all claims that depend thereon, are not obvious over any combination of the cited references. Withdrawal of the rejections and a timely notice of allowance are respectfully requested.

In view of the above remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that the application is now in condition for allowance. The Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned to resolve efficiently any formal matters or to discuss any aspects of the application or of this response. Otherwise, early notification of allowable subject matter is respectfully requested.

No additional fees are believed to be due. However, the Director is hereby authorized to charge all required fees (including any extension of time fees) and to credit any overpayment of fees in this and any concurrent or future correspondence to Deposit Account No. 041133.
